executive_summary: lib/sub-agents/database/schema-validator.js's staticFileValidation() has never found any migration file for any SD: line 107's `await glob(pattern)` uses glob@7.2.3's callback/EventEmitter API, which is not thenable, so allFiles was always empty regardless of pattern. This delivered a fix that (1) promisifies the glob call and adds cwd:getRepoRoot()+absolute:true for correctness across worktrees, (2) adds 'database/chairman-gated/*.sql' as the originally-requested fourth migrationPaths entry, and (3) adds a RED-first regression test suite (lib/sub-agents/database/database.test.js) that fails against the original code and passes against the fix, using disposable fixture files under both database/migrations/ and database/chairman-gated/ with proper afterEach cleanup.

functional_requirements.title: staticFileValidation() actually discovers existing migration files
functional_requirements.description: lib/sub-agents/database/schema-validator.js:98-114: replace the broken `await glob(pattern)` (glob@7.2.3 callback API misused as a Promise, always resolving to the Glob EventEmitter instance rather than the match array) with `await globAsync(pattern, { cwd: getRepoRoot(), absolute: true })` where globAsync = promisify(glob). Verified live: staticFileValidation('SD-KNOWLEDGE-001', {}) went from verdict=NOT_REQUIRED/0 files (on unmodified main, despite 3 real files in database/migrations/*.sql genuinely referencing that SD ID) to verdict=INVALID/5 files found.

The three pre-existing migrationPaths entries (database/migrations, supabase/migrations, migrations) all resolve correctly

risks.risk: Downstream consumers of staticFileValidation() (lib/sub-agents/database/index.js:216) currently only ever received verdict=NOT_REQUIRED and short-circuit to PASS/confidence=100 at line 219-225 -- fixing the glob call means, for the FIRST TIME, index.js's contract-compliance validation (line 258) and Phase-2 DB verification will actually execute for database-type SDs with real migration files. This could surface previously-hidden migration content issues that were never checked.
risks.mitigation: Grepped and confirmed index.js:216 is the ONLY production call site; its downstream handling (contractValidation, databaseVerification) already has defined branches for VALID/INVALID/INCOMPLETE verdicts that were simply dead code before -- no new code path is introduced, only previously-unreachable existing code becomes reachable. Blast radius is scoped to sd_type='database' SDs (per CLAUDE_LEAD.md's SD Type-Specific Requirements table, the DATABASE sub-agent is required for that type specifically), not universal.

risks.risk: The syntax-validation heuristic later in the same function (naive odd/even single-quote counting, lines 176-189) will now actually execute against real file content for the first time, and can false-positive on legitimate SQL (e.g. dollar-quoted PL/pgSQL bodies containing an apostrophe in a comment). Observed live: it flagged one 2025-10-15 migration file as INVALID (Unclosed single quotes) during manual verification.
risks.mitigation: This is a separate, pre-existing heuristic bug in a different code block than the one this SD fixes -- not touched here, not caused by this fix, and out of scope for a bugfix-type SD targeting the file-discovery defect specifically. Noted for awareness; not blocking.
